content_sections.heading: Hindustan Copper Apprentice Vacancy 2026 - 171 Seats
content_sections.text: The Malanjkhand Copper Project has announced 171 apprenticeship training seats in 19 trades . Electrician has the highest allocation with 36 seats, followed by Computer Assistant (COPA) with 20 seats. The training seats may be increased or decreased according to the requirements of Hindustan Copper Limited.

content_sections.heading: HCL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Applicants must have passed Class 10 or Matriculation under the 10+2 education system or an equivalent examination . For trades numbered 4 to 19, candidates must also possess an ITI qualification in the relevant trade from a recognized institute. Important: The notice contains a minor inconsistency: the eligibility paragraph explicitly identifies Sl. Nos. 1 and 3 as 10th-pass entries, while the main vacancy table also shows no technical qualification for Sl. No. 2, Shotfirer/Blaster (Mines). The selection paragraph separately confirms that Blaster (Mines) is assessed on Class 10 marks alone. Candidates applying for these three trades should follow the trade-wise qualification table and verify the relevant application instructions. The notification states that candidates possessing higher professional qualifications such as a Diploma, B.E. or equivalent qualification will not be considered under this apprenticeship engagement. Candidates with academic degrees such as B.A., B.Sc. or B.Com. will not receive additional weightage in the selection process. Candidates who passed ITI in 2025 or earlier must upload an affidavit on non-judicial stamp paper, sworn before a Magistrate or Notary Public. The affidavit must declare that the candidate has neither undergone apprenticeship training previously nor taken employment anywhere. The required affidavit must be uploaded as a PDF smaller than 1 MB.

content_sections.text: The age limit is 18 to 25 years as on 1 November 2026 . Upper-age relaxation is available for eligible SC, ST and OBC candidates. Candidates should calculate their age using the prescribed cut-off date and provide valid documents supporting any claimed relaxation.

content_sections.text: Selected Trade Apprentices will receive a stipend as admissible under the applicable apprenticeship rules . The notification does not announce a specific monthly stipend for individual trades. Candidates should not assume a fixed amount without confirmation from the company.

content_sections.heading: HCL Apprentice Training Duration 2026
content_sections.text: The apprenticeship training duration varies according to the trade. Most trades offer one year of training, while Mate Mines, Shotfirer/Blaster and Driver-cum-Mechanic have longer training periods. content_sections.heading: Hindustan Copper Apprentice Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: Selection will be based on a merit list prepared using Class 10 and ITI marks . The official notification does not prescribe a separate written examination or interview. Online Registration: Candidates complete Government apprenticeship portal registration and HCL online application. Merit Calculation: Marks are evaluated using the prescribed Class 10 and ITI weightage. Shortlisting: The company prepares the shortlisted candidates list. Certificate Verification: Educational and eligibility certificates are verified. Medical Fitness: Candidates must satisfy Hindustan Copper Limited's medical standards. Apprenticeship Engagement: Selected candidates complete the applicable apprenticeship contract formalities. For ITI-based trades, the merit calculation gives 70% weightage to Class 10 marks and 30% weightage to ITI marks . Merit Percentage = (Class 10 Percentage x 0.70) + (ITI Percentage x 0.30) This is an illustrative calculation, not an actual cut-off. For trades where ITI is not required, the merit list is prepared using 100% weightage of Class 10 Board marks . The notification specifically identifies Mate Mines and Blaster (Mines) in its merit instructions. The main qualification table also lists Driver-cum-Mechanic (LMV) without an ITI requirement. If two or more candidates obtain the same merit marks, the older candidate will be given preference. Where Class 10 results are awarded in CGPA, the notification prescribes conversion into percentage by multiplying the CGPA by 9.5 . For example, a CGPA of 8.0 corresponds to 76% under this prescribed calculation.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for Hindustan Copper Limited Apprentice Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Candidates must complete both stages described below. Visit the Government apprenticeship portal at www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in . Create or access the candidate apprenticeship profile. Complete the registration using the required personal and contact information. Ensure the candidate's name, parents' names, date of birth and Aadhaar details match the relevant educational records. Complete Aadhaar verification and the required eKYC details. Update bank account details in the candidate profile. Enter the appropriate Class 10 or ITI educational qualification details. Search for the establishment Hindustan Copper Limited, Malanjkhand Copper Project . Locate the relevant apprenticeship opportunity for the chosen trade. Apply for the appropriate trade and save the application confirmation. Record the apprenticeship registration number generated by the portal. Retain a copy of the apprenticeship profile and applied opportunity details. Important: HCL follows the "One Applicant - One Application" rule. If multiple applications are submitted, only the first submitted application will be considered.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for Hindustan Copper Apprentice Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must provide the records required by the apprenticeship registration and HCL online application systems. Class 10 marksheet and certificate. Relevant ITI marksheet and trade certificate, where required. Aadhaar details for profile verification. Government apprenticeship registration number. Government apprenticeship profile copy. Applied apprenticeship opportunity confirmation. Recent passport-size colour photograph. Candidate signature in English using black ink. Affidavit for candidates who passed ITI in 2025 or earlier. Relevant category certificate, where claiming the applicable benefit. Other certificates requested at the verification stage. Photographs must be passport-size colour images, and signatures must be written in English with black ink.

content_sections.heading: HCL Apprentice Aadhaar and Profile Verification Requirements
content_sections.text: The notification requires applicants to maintain accurate and fully Aadhaar-verified profiles on the apprenticeship portal. Details such as name, father's name, mother's name and date of birth must match the Class 10 and ITI records. Applicants must ensure their bank account details and eKYC are updated. Incorrect or mismatched information may result in rejection or problems during apprenticeship contract processing.

content_sections.heading: Hindustan Copper Apprentice Medical Fitness 2026
content_sections.text: Engagement of shortlisted candidates is subject to their being declared medically fit according to Hindustan Copper Limited's requirements.

content_sections.heading: HCL Apprentice Contract and Training Conditions
content_sections.text: After selection, the apprenticeship contract must be generated through the Government portal and accepted by the candidate according to the notified procedure. The notice states that the contract is subject to approval by RDSDE Bhopal . Candidates must regularly check their registered email and apprenticeship portal for contract-related instructions. Candidates who have already completed apprenticeship training under NAPS are not eligible for another apprenticeship contract in a different trade. Candidates with an active contract elsewhere must satisfy the prescribed resignation and acceptance requirements before another contract can be processed.

content_sections.heading: Common Reasons for Rejection of HCL Apprentice Applications
content_sections.text: Not completing both mandatory application stages. Not entering the apprenticeship registration number in the HCL form. Applying for a trade without the prescribed qualification. Submitting multiple HCL applications. Providing incorrect Class 10 or ITI information. Mismatch between Aadhaar profile and educational certificates. Failing to upload the applicable affidavit for earlier ITI pass-outs. Providing false or fabricated certificates. Failing to satisfy the prescribed age limit. Having already completed an apprenticeship contract under the applicable restriction. Not meeting the company's medical fitness standards. The company reserves the right to cancel candidature where eligibility conditions are not satisfied or incorrect information has been furnished.
